brief.headline: Revenue fell 80.8% to 5178 while sessions fell only 4.1%, with a large AOV drop that needs tracking verification.
executive_summary: Sessions were 26342, down 4.1% from 27478, and conversion rate was 1.18, down 13.8% from 1.36.
Average order value was 15.32, down 77.3% from 67.42.
No calendar events are provided to explain seasonality.

what_changed.title: Total revenue and order value fell sharply
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 5178 vs 26966 (-80.8%), AOV was 15.32 vs 67.42 (-77.3%), and revenue per session was 0.2 vs 0.98 (-80%).

what_changed.title: Traffic was stable but conversion weakened
what_changed.detail: Sessions were 26342 vs 27478 (-4.1%), users were 21590 vs 22647 (-4.7%), and conversion rate was 1.18 vs 1.36 (-13.8%).

what_changed.title: Checkout step weakened
what_changed.detail: Add to cart -> checkout was 53.31 vs 56.62 (-5.9%, -3.31 points) and was the biggest funnel leak.

what_changed.title: Some countries showed weaker product view to cart
what_changed.detail: Canada view_to_cart_rate was 16.85 vs 22.11 (-23.8%) and India was 13.29 vs 16.91 (-21.4%).

what_changed.title: Organic traffic increased
what_changed.detail: Organic sessions were 13640 vs 12036 (+13.3%) and organic users were 12644 vs 11351 (+11.4%).

likely_drivers: No calendar events are provided, so seasonality cannot be explained from the payload.
The total revenue drop is likely consistent with the large drop in AOV (15.32 vs 67.42) and revenue per session (0.2 vs 0.98), while sessions and users changed less.
The funnel change is consistent with a weaker Add to cart -> checkout step (53.31 vs 56.62).
The revenue drop is consistent with lower revenue on high-revenue items, including Google Crewneck Sweatshirt Green revenue of 275 vs 1925 and Gift Card- $100.00 revenue of 0 vs 1200.
risks: If the AOV and revenue per session drop is not verified, marketing may act on a tracking error.
If the checkout leak is not addressed, more carts may stop before purchase.
If high-value at-risk customers are not retained, the at-risk high value segment may keep growing from 470 to 668.

actions.action: Verify the AOV and revenue per session tracking setup before acting on the revenue drop.
actions.why: The total AOV and revenue per session anomalies are flagged for tracking verification.
actions.evidence: AOV current 15.32, previous 67.42, change -77.3%; revenue per session current 0.2, previous 0.98, change -80%.

actions.action: Review the checkout flow after add to cart.
actions.why: The Add to cart -> checkout step was the biggest funnel leak.
actions.evidence: Add to cart -> checkout current 53.31, previous 56.62, change -5.9%, -3.31 points.

actions.action: Build a retention list for at-risk high-value customers.
actions.why: The at-risk high value segment grew and has high average spend.
actions.evidence: At-risk high value customers current 668, previous 470, avg_spend 199.57, avg_recency_days 65.6.
